structured_requirements.title: Candidate Registration
structured_requirements.description: Candidates must be able to register, verify email, and create a profile within 90 seconds. Expected 5000 new registrations per day at peak.

structured_requirements.title: Resume Upload and Storage
structured_requirements.description: Candidates upload resumes (PDF/DOCX, max 10MB). System must store and index for search. Expected 3000 uploads/day, 50GB/month storage growth.
acceptance_criteria: Upload completes in P95 < 5 seconds for 10MB on 10Mbps
Resume searchable within 60 seconds of upload

structured_requirements.title: Recruiter Dashboard Performance
structured_requirements.description: Recruiter dashboard must load within 2 seconds showing up to 500 applications. Support 200 concurrent recruiters.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard loads in P95 < 2 seconds with 500 applications

structured_requirements.title: System Availability
structured_requirements.description: System must maintain 99.9% uptime during business hours (6am-midnight). Maximum 8.7 hours downtime per year.

structured_requirements.title: Authentication and Security
structured_requirements.description: OAuth 2.0 authentication for all user-facing endpoints. SOC2 Type II compliance required. Token expiry 15 minutes.

structured_requirements.title: AI Matching Pipeline
structured_requirements.description: AI matching service must sustain 1000 requests/minute during peak hours with P99 latency < 5 seconds. Requires GPU inference.

structured_requirements.title: Data Encryption
structured_requirements.description: All data at rest encrypted with AES-256. Key rotation every 90 days. Applies to all databases and object storage.
acceptance_criteria: AES-256 encryption verified on all stores

structured_requirements.title: Observability and Monitoring
structured_requirements.description: All services emit structured logs to central aggregator. Alerts fire within 60 seconds of SLO breach. Health endpoints on all services.
